name: heimdall
description: Open-source game benchmarking: capture, share, and auto-diagnose frame-time data.

minimumAgeExceptions.wrangler@4.110.0: Security exception: replaces the 30-day-soaked 4.100.0 release whose Miniflare tree contains patched undici and ws advisories (GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g, GHSA-vxpw-j846-p89q, GHSA-hm92-r4w5-c3mj, GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p).
minimumAgeExceptions.next@16.4.1: Security exception: 16.2.11 carries five critical unauthenticated RCEs (GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw and GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4 in Image Optimization, GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr in `use cache`, GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36 on Windows hosts, GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j in next/og) plus SSRF, cache-poisoning and DoS advisories. Nothing below 16.4.1 patches all of them and no 16.2.x backport exists; lowest patched release, preferred over 16.4.2/16.4.3 for soak.
minimumAgeExceptions.zod@4.6.6: Security exception: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections) is fixed only from 4.6.6; zod validates every upload and API payload. Lowest patched release.
minimumAgeExceptions.vitest@4.1.12: Security exception: GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8 (code injection via unauthenticated manual-mock registration) and GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 (path traversal in @vitest/mocker) — 4.1.12 is the lowest release fixing both. Test tooling only.
minimumAgeExceptions.vite@8.1.6: Security exception: GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22 (files outside server.fs.allow served) and three launch-editor command-injection/bypass advisories on Windows, the dev platform. Lowest patched release. Dev server only.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
